title: CORE DataSet
description: A CORE DataSet manifest: the envelope of a dataset and its member artifacts referenced by versioned CORE URN (data structures, mappings, pipelines, data sources, data sinks). The backend composes it from the DataSet entity and its relations; the members themselves are separate CORE artifacts. This is the stored manifest form — member content is not inlined here.

id.description: CORE URN of this DataSet (logical, or with a trailing :version).

datastructureRefs.description: Versioned CORE URNs of the DataStructures used in this dataset.

mappingRefs.description: Versioned CORE URNs of the Mappings used in this dataset.

pipelineRefs.description: Versioned CORE URNs of the Pipelines in this dataset.

dataSourceRefs.description: Versioned CORE URNs of the DataSource configurations in this dataset.

dataSinkRefs.description: Versioned CORE URNs of the DataSink configurations in this dataset.
